headline: US Strikes Iran 12 Nights Straight After Missile Attack on Jordan
subheadline: US CENTCOM confirmed the twelfth consecutive night of strikes on Iranian naval, missile storage, and air defense sites, while Iran fired four missiles at Aqaba.
lede: For the twelfth consecutive night, US CENTCOM struck Iranian naval capabilities, missile storage, and air defense assets, while Iranian forces launched four ballistic missiles at Aqaba, Jordan, with explosions heard in Eilat, Israel. President Trump warned that any Iranian fire toward vessels in the Strait of Hormuz will trigger US strikes on one Iranian bridge or power plant per attack, including near Tehran, and a US missile strike on the Shalamcheh border crossing killed two pilgrims. In Ukraine, President Zelenskyy's administration replaced Commander‑in‑Chief Aleksandr Syrsky with Mikhail Drapatiy and appointed Igor Skibiuk as Chief of General Staff as Russian forces claimed control of Artelnoye in Kharkiv and Blagovatnoye in Zaporizhzhia. Ukrainian drones hit Wildberries logistics centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol and an oil depot in Armavir, Russian air defense shot down 80 Ukrainian UAVs in one day, and an FPV drone strike on a Kharkiv gas station injured five workers.

sections.title: Ukrainian Leadership Shift Amid Russian Advances
sections.body: Ukraine replaced Commander‑in‑Chief Aleksandr Syrsky with Mikhail Drapatiy and appointed Major General Igor Skibiuk as Chief of General Staff. Russian MoD claimed control of Artelnoye in the Kharkiv region and Blagovatnoye in the Zaporizhzhia region amid ongoing advances. Ukrainian drones struck Wildberries logistics centers in Krasnodar and Stavropol regions and an oil depot in Armavir, while Russian air defense shot down 80 Ukrainian UAVs over Russian territory in one day. An FPV drone attack on a Kharkiv gas station injured five workers, and ballistic missile threats were reported from northeast axes and an Iskander‑M launch threat from occupied Crimea.

sections.title: US Strikes Iran Amid Escalating Threats
sections.body: For the twelfth consecutive night, US CENTCOM struck Iranian naval capabilities, missile storage, and air defense assets. Iran launched four ballistic missiles at Aqaba, Jordan, with explosions heard in Eilat, Israel. President Trump warned that any Iranian fire toward vessels in the Strait of Hormuz will trigger US strikes on one Iranian bridge or power plant per attack, including near Tehran, and a US missile strike on the Shalamcheh border crossing killed two pilgrims. Multiple explosions were reported near Bushehr air base, possibly from US strikes launched from Bahrain, while the IRGC Aerospace Commander threatened to cut electricity to Gulf states if US attacks Iranian bridges or power plants.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The data shows a pattern of reciprocal kinetic escalation: twelve straight nights of US strikes on Iran met with Iranian ballistic missile fire on Jordan and explicit US threats to hit Iranian bridges, power plants, and nearby Tehran infrastructure. In Ukraine, the leadership transition coincides with Russian territorial claims near Kharkiv and sustained missile‑drone threats, while Ukrainian deep strikes on Russian logistics demonstrate growing asymmetric capability but risk further escalation.
